Landed costs (brokerage fees, import fees, duties, inbound freight, product cost) belong in Inventory on the balance sheet. They expense through COGS (50000) only when the item sells — not when you pay them.

1) Every account needs a clear purpose — no 'miscellaneous' or 'ask accountant'.  2) Post to subaccounts, not header accounts.  3) Deactivate accounts you no longer use.  4) Balance simplicity vs. insight; use Classes to compare channels instead of duplicating accounts.
